marketing_cta_description: Start organizing your daily schedule and monitoring critical endpoints with Beep today.
marketing_cta_title: Ready to streamline your alerts and reminders?
marketing_faq_a1: Beep analyzes common date, time, recurring patterns, and tags in your input. You can type phrases like 'tomorrow at 3pm meeting #work' or 'every Friday at 5pm submit report', and it will automatically extract the execution time and metadata.
marketing_faq_a2: We support Browser Web Push (even when the tab is closed), Email notifications, and custom Webhook integrations.
marketing_faq_a3: Beeper Probes are automated background workers that periodically check endpoint health, SSL certificate validity, ping intervals, or custom metrics, and notify your channels when status changes.
marketing_faq_a4: Yes! You can create team accounts, invite members via invite links, and share notification channels and probe dashboards within your team workspace.
marketing_faq_a5: Yes, Beep provides RESTful API endpoints with access token authentication so you can programmatically create beeps, check probe statuses, and trigger notifications from your scripts.
marketing_faq_description: Have questions? We've got answers. If you need further help, feel free to reach out.
marketing_faq_q1: How does natural language reminder parsing work?
marketing_faq_q2: What notification channels are currently supported?
marketing_faq_q4: Can I collaborate with my team on Beep?
marketing_faq_q5: Is there an API available for programmatic use?
marketing_feature_1_description: Type reminders in plain language. Beep automatically parses relative dates, times, recurring rules, and tags.
marketing_feature_2_description: Deploy heartbeat monitors and periodic health checks to catch downtime, HTTP errors, or latency spikes early.
marketing_feature_3_description: Deliver alerts instantly via Browser Web Push, Email, or Webhook without complicated setups.
marketing_feature_4_description: Whether it's a one-time reminder or complex cron expressions, Solid Queue guarantees exact-time execution.
marketing_feature_5_description: Isolate personal reminders from team operational alerts with dedicated workspace slugs and role permissions.
marketing_feature_6_description: Integrate Beep into your CI/CD pipelines, backend microservices, or custom scripts using standard JSON APIs.
marketing_features_description: Everything you need to stay on top of your daily workflows, mission-critical servers, and team notifications.
marketing_footer_subtitle: Built for creators, developers, and high-performance teams.
marketing_hero_description: Beep unites natural-language scheduled reminders, automated server & API probes, and instant multi-channel alerts into one unified hub.
marketing_hero_prompt_input: Remind me next Monday at 9:00 AM to review database backups and renew SSL certs #ops
marketing_hero_title: Never miss a critical event, probe, or reminder again
marketing_how_it_works_description: Get your workspace configured and start receiving mission-critical updates in less than two minutes.
marketing_how_it_works_title: Up and running in 3 simple steps
marketing_step_1_description: Input a natural language task or choose a ready-to-run monitoring probe template from our gallery.
marketing_step_1_title: Create a Beep or Install a Probe
marketing_step_2_description: Enable browser Web Push, configure notification email, or connect a webhook endpoint in just one click.
marketing_step_3_description: Beep continuously runs in the background, executing health checks and pinging you right on time.
marketing_testimonial_1_quote: Beep replaced three separate reminder bots and an uptime tool for me. Scheduling in plain text saves me time every single day.
marketing_testimonial_2_quote: The Beeper probe app gallery is a game changer. We caught an expiring SSL certificate and an API regression days ahead of time via Web Push.
marketing_testimonial_3_quote: Instant browser web push and clean webhook integration. It's the most responsive and distraction-free notification hub I've used.
marketing_testimonials_description: See how developers and teams use Beep to replace clunky bots, catch outages, and stay focused.
marketing_testimonials_title: Loved by solo makers, trusted by engineering teams
